about: The hare's run: four poses of the body's own Run (its bound, damped to 0.5 of the file's stretch and tuck so four poses keep a steadier silhouette), judged at 520 ms a tile (a placeholder inside the pose-rate cap: a stride of 17 to 22 px across the views, drawn in four poses, holds its feet only up to about 125 px/s; the hunting rules set the real pace). The foot-slide limit is the wolf's 2 px for a quadruped's four-pose loop.
